description: Ministry of Defence - General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University. Amendments to the Closing Date.
reasoning: This gazette notification announces an extension of the application deadline for undergraduate programmes at General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University due to delayed exam results. It involves educational administration (university admissions) and does not fit any of the government structure/personnel categories (Types 1-3) or specialized categories (Types 4-9) as it is not about government organizational changes, personnel appointments, land, legal/commercial matters, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
